summary: The technology director of a school urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern public education.

claims.argument: St. Benedict’s Preparatory School has received $146,322 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025
claims.evidence_quote: St. Benedict’s Preparatory School has received $146,322 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $29,264 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
